blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla said Friday that he won’t be running for public office in the 2028 National Elections, contradicting his previous pronouncement that he would be open to be Vice President Sara Duterte’s running mate. Padilla expressed his latest decision in a social media post, citing the age of his children. “I have no plans to run for politics. My children are still young, and a quiet Islamic life is what I dream and aspire to have,” Padilla said in his post.
